entities.summary: French naval officer, explorer, and filmmaker (1910-1997) who co-developed the Aqua-Lung (modern scuba) and pioneered underwater exploration. His ship Calypso and television series The Undersea World of Jacques Cousteau brought ocean science to millions and catalyzed the marine conservation movement.
